# check-id: # A FAIL whose check id appears here is reported XFAIL, and a PASS is reported
# XPASS. XPASS is the signal to close the issue and delete the row.
# Without this file every run re-files the same open caveats and the report
# buries the new findings under the known ones. Add a row when an issue is
# filed; delete it when the issue closes.
# A row whose check id no suite produces is reported at the end of a full run
# as "known issues with no check yet". That is the coverage gap, listed rather
# than discovered later: the id names the check somebody still has to write.
# Seeded from the open caveats on 2026-09-14.
